Save a compiled table script to an R file

Source: R/compile.R
kst_save.Rd

Compiles the spec with kst_compile and writes the resulting R script to a file with an informational header comment block. The saved file is a self-contained plain R script that can be read, reviewed, version- controlled, or sourced directly.

Usage

kst_save(json_spec, file, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

json_spec

JSON string or path to a .json file.

file

Output path (typically a .R file).

overwrite

Logical. If FALSE (default), stops when file already exists, protecting manually-edited scripts.

Value

The normalised absolute path to the written file, invisibly.

Details

To execute the saved script:


env      <- new.env(parent = environment())
env$data <- my_data
result   <- source("my_table.R", local = env)$value

See also

kst_compile, kst_validate_spec

Examples

spec <- '{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "table_spec": {
    "id": "demo",
    "parameter":  { "age": { "variable": "AGE" } },
    "statistics": { "n": { "fun": "length" } },
    "groups":     { "by": ["TRT"] },
    "layout":     { "row_structure": "parameter_stat" }
  }
}'
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".R")
kst_save(spec, tmp)
cat(readLines(tmp), sep = "\n")
